description: Docked panel showing the document's version history. Lists saved versions with their metadata and offers create, preview, return-to-current, and restore (with confirmation) actions, and can render an inline diff of two selected versions via TmDocumentDiffViewer.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the panel should close.

parameters.name: OnCreateVersion
parameters.description: Raised when the create-version dialog should open.

parameters.name: OnRestoreVersion
parameters.description: Raised when the previewed version should be restored.

parameters.name: OnReturnToCurrent
parameters.description: Raised when preview should return to the current document.

parameters.name: OnSelectVersion
parameters.description: Raised when a historical version should be previewed.

parameters.name: PreviewVersion
parameters.description: Version currently previewed by the editor.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether create actions should be disabled.
